description:
Author sentences the classifier labeled with one role, across every stored
    record, each with its probability and paper. Abstract-tier records
    cover limitation, result and main_claim; full-text records add
    condition, citation and measurement.

arxiv_id.description: One paper, or empty for every stored record.
arxiv_id.title: Arxiv Id

query.description: Words to match in the author's sentence. Empty returns the role.
query.title: Query

role.description: limitation, condition, result, main_claim, citation, or measurement.
role.title: Role

name: find_passages

outputSchema.description: Author sentences of one role with the classifier's probabilities.
outputSchema.title: Passages

title: Find sentences by role across records
